name: Wall Sit

instructions.description: Stand with your back against a wall and feet a short distance in front of you.
Slide down the wall until your knees are bent to a comfortable angle.
Hold the position with the back supported and weight evenly through both feet.
Press through the feet to slide back up when the hold is complete.

performanceMetrics.notes: Choose a knee angle that can be held with good form.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use a shallower knee bend to reduce the load.

commentsNotes: Do not let the knees collapse inward.
